newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norsk Hydro extends contract for support vessel.
newsitem.headline: Norsk Hydro extends contract for support vessel.

text.p: Norske Hydro ASA said on Thursday it had extended an agreement with K/S Borgila Dolphin II Fred Olsen & Co in connection to services related to Hydro's drilling activity.
The contract for the Borgila Dolphin vessel has been extended from April 1, 1998 to December 31, 2001. The contract is worth 370 million crowns.

Borgila Dolphin is currently employed as a mud station for drilling at the North Sea Oseberg C platform. During the extended period it will be used at the planned Oseberg East development and for future drilling off Oseberg C, Norsk Hydro said in a statement.
